svg.aria-label: How one season's pot is shared
svg.text: How one season's pot is shared
Example: 100k CHOC, 2k eligible players; 15 % shared evenly, 85 % by rank with weights 1/rank. Top 10 players: 31 % of the pot, top 100: 55 %.
Prize by rank, all players (log scale)
Last place still receives 12 CHOC. Every amount is rounded down to whole CHOC; the coins left over stay in the pot.
